The site is Community Woodland Trust — Memorial Tree Fund & Dedication Ledger, a expense-tracker web application for Memorial tree fund contributions and planting site tracker.

Owner brief: "Our community park trust collects voluntary contributions for planting memorial trees, but our donation ledger tool corrupts running totals on reload and lacks basic form validation. Fix the tool so contributions are saved on the server, negative contribution amounts are rejected with clear error feedback, and the ledger table is accessible to screen readers."

Locale & copy conventions (en-US): Use $ prices, US English spelling and month-day dates. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-29/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Community Woodland Trust — Memorial Tree Fund & Dedication Ledger: the page for memorial tree fund contributions and planting site tracker, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #14532d (cw-green), #854d0e (cw-brass), #ffffff (cw-card), #bbf7d0 (cw-border), #f0fdf4 (cw-bg), #14532d (cw-text), #4b5563 (cw-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--cw-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a running total that does not match the listed entries; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Community Woodland Trust — Memorial Tree Fund & Dedication Ledger as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Contributor name", "Contribution amount", "Dedication message", "Planting site").

User journey context: View current community tree fund progress and memorial tree planting sites. Enter donor name, dedication message, and contribution dollar amount to submit. View the donation confirmation receipt and reload the public ledger to verify the new contribution.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
